title: General Class Unit Hard Windows
objective: Add explicit bounded hard-discriminant acquisition and offline replay

handoff.summary: Separate bounded hard-window acquisition policy with eight fixed windows, pinned exclusion input snapshots, immutable dispatch/raw-result receipts and deterministic offline replay. Explicit fetch only; no automatic retries. Exports distinct hard-window-v1 source identity. Adds only this task's exact build-partition metadata exclusion and near-name regressions.

Coordinator must supply all prior and active screening inputs; omitted exclusions cannot be discovered automatically.
Optional native psql required only for explicit fetch; absence yields client-unavailable. Windows file fsync retained, directory fsync unavailable.
Not mathematical qualification or isomorphism deduplication; reference time bands and holdout eligibility remain pending.
Contract remains active: coordinator requested focused validation for interim tooling review, deferring broad build-dependent checks.
next_steps: Coordinator review, then explicitly approve and run offline plan plus bounded fetch with complete exclusion inputs.
